name: Electrum-LTC
description: Electrum pattern: pinned coin-address-signed version blob; notify-only.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Electrum-LTC's Qt updater retrieves a version JSON document, accepts it only when a signature from the hard-coded Litecoin address verifies, and presents the electrum-ltc.org download page for a newer version. The inspected flow does not download or install the package itself.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; the claim is limited to the inspected Qt checker and does not establish behavior of other distribution channels.
